verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Sentry serves an llms.txt at docs.sentry.io (HTTP 200) whose content is written for developers "and their agents". Sentry also documents agent-oriented onboarding: one command teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Grok how to install Sentry, and the MCP server lets assistants read documentation. missing for 10: evidence on the depth of the llms.txt content (e.g., a full-text variant or per-page markdown docs).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: One command teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok how to install and configure Sentry for you.
Connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation, and managing projects
